name: claude-vault-companion
description: Keeps the open Claude Code chats of this project identical on every machine: opens sessions the other machine opened, closes the ones it closed, live in this window, and exports this window's tabs when they change.

claudeVaultCompanion.mode.description: auto (default): merge the other machine's open chats into this window live (open by session id / close by tab), announced in the status bar; ask: show a toast first; off: do nothing.

claudeVaultCompanion.maxLiveOpens.description: How many chats a single live merge opens (newest activity first); the rest follows in later batches, one batch per minute.

claudeVaultCompanion.openDelayMs.description: Pause between two chats opened by a live merge.

claudeVaultCompanion.minFreeMemoryMB.description: Skip a live merge (and retry later) while the machine has less free memory than this.

claudeVaultCompanion.idleSeconds.description: auto mode only: reopen only after this many seconds without keyboard/editor activity in this window.

commands.title: Claude Vault: Merge the other machine's chats into this window now
Claude Vault: Export this window's open chats now
